Package com.lemarketjames.auth.security

Class JwtService

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.auth.security.JwtService
@Service public class JwtService extends Object
Service class for JWT token generation and validation. Handles creating tokens with user information and verifying token validity.

      public Optional<String> extractUsername(String token)

      Returns:
